items.abstract: <jats:p>Taking high performance concrete (HPC) in hydraulic engineering as an example, this paper discusses the influence of different mixing methods of slag powder and fly ash on its frost resistance and chloride ion permeability. The results show that the compressive strength decreases with the addition of HPC; Proper addition of mineral admixtures is beneficial to improve the anti chloride ion permeability of HPC and reduce the electric flux; The HPC flux of 28d and 90 reaches 680C and 280C, when the mass ratio of slag powder to fly ash is 15:35 and the content of mineral admixture is 35 %; The frost resistance of HPC gradually deteriorates with the increase of mineral admixture under the condition of constant air content and water binder ratio. The frost resistance grade of HPC without mineral admixture reaches F200, and its frost resistance is the best.</jats:p>
